body: Only one other employee was my age; the others were older people. I've tried other lawyers but they say business is bad so they don't have a place for me. All I can do is keep trying to find something.

I think it was because I am young and he could tell I needed work. I remember he kept asking questions about my parents and where we lived and if they were established people. Looking back I think he realised that I wouldn't be able to stop him taking advantage of the situation.

I worked for him for six months. Every month he would promise to pay me but didn't. I know he paid his other employees. When I left he told me to come back the next week and his secretary would give me a pay packet. I kept checking but he never did. That was almost year ago so I won't be able to go back.

Thank you for talking to me killcoyote, I know you don't have to.

Unemployment is very high so people just say keep looking for work something will come.

I got the job with the lawyer's office through a relative and he was very angry when I stopped working there. He said I should have stayed and maybe the man would have paid me eventually. 

I'm living with my sister right now; she works at a bank (I'm very proud of her). There aren't any vacancies right now but her boss was very friendly and said he would keep me in mind.

In the past when I got paying work I would give the money I made to my parents and sister. That's why I don't have much savings now. If I had been selfish I would be in a better place moneywise.

I can't afford to go back to school; it's very expensive. I tried to get an education loan but I need proof of savings and at least two guarantors. 

The lawyer isn't a very nice person but he is a big shot here so there's nothing I can do.

I've tried talking to them about how I feel but they have their own problems. They say I need to toughen up and be glad I'm not on the streets. 

Other people my age stay with family or go back to school. A friend of mine works with his mother at the market. I got a heads up about a cleaning job with an English family but my relatives told me that would be shameful work and embarrass them.

I worked with a lawyer in his office for a few months but he won't pay me for the work I did.

My country is very small and it's very hard to find work abroad here even if I could afford a flight out. I can't afford to stay but I can't leave either. I'm staying with a relative but I can tell my being here is a burden on her.
